title: Perforated cells · split and recombine
description: A lobed shape separates into three perforated objects and rejoins. Sampled area follows the endpoint measure curve.

title: Rings · one to three
description: A ring separates into three rings and recombines. Holes are part of the signed fields, with checked area calibration.

title: Soft lobes · one to three
description: Filled lobed geometry separates and merges through smooth contact necks.

title: Crosses · contact and separation
description: Cross-shaped material separates into three objects and reconnects. This tests narrow branches and contact geometry.

title: Square frames · separation and reunion
description: Hollow planar frames move apart and reconnect, retaining a field representation of their interiors.

title: Plane → saddle → wave
description: An actual zero-thickness sheet bends through three height fields. It has surface area but no occupied solid volume.

title: Flat sheet → rolled sheet
description: A planar sheet bends into an open cylindrical surface. No artificial thickness or solid-volume calibration is introduced.

title: Torus · changing proportions
description: A closed toroidal mesh changes its embedding. This example tests surface correspondence, not volume preservation.

title: Ellipsoid · changing axes
description: A closed smooth surface moves through distinct ellipsoidal states. There is no cube-to-sphere transition.

title: Sheet → helicoid
description: A flat sheet twists into a helicoid. Drag to inspect its zero-thickness geometry from different depths.

title: Disk → dome → disk
description: A two-dimensional disk lifts into an open dome and flattens again. Surface deformation does not require creating solid volume.

title: Function graphs
description: Persistent sampled graph strokes interpolate between three function states.

title: Deforming coordinate lattice
description: A Cartesian lattice deforms while each line retains its identity and stroke width.

title: Plus ↔ times
description: The same two strokes rotate between mathematical operators, without fading or replacement.

title: Circle ↔ figure-eight
description: One continuous stroke changes its embedding. Crossing strokes may overlap; they are not solid volumes.

title: Node-link graph layouts
description: Graph nodes and their persistent edges move between layouts with explicit correspondence.

title: Block hierarchy
description: Persistent blocks reorganize across layouts using the same VKF state interpolation.

title: Discriminant · preserve 4ac
description: The LaTeX engine supplies the actual glyphs and layout. VKF moves persistent groups between layouts without fading; 4ac remains one unit.

title: Distribution · preserve term groups
description: Actual LaTeX glyphs and term groups move between one-line and multiline layouts through compiled VKF interpolation.

title: Fractions · grouped layout
description: The existing LaTeX engine supplies glyphs, scripts and rules. VKF interpolates their persistent groups; no replacement fonts or crossfades.

title: Matrix · rearrange entries
description: The existing LaTeX engine supplies glyphs, scripts and rules. VKF interpolates their persistent groups; no replacement fonts or crossfades.

title: Integrals · multiline layout
description: The existing LaTeX engine supplies glyphs, scripts and rules. VKF interpolates their persistent groups; no replacement fonts or crossfades.

title: Quadratic formula · retained layout
description: The existing LaTeX engine supplies glyphs, scripts and rules. VKF interpolates their persistent groups; no replacement fonts or crossfades.
